item.title: Suspect in downtown Minneapolis mass shooting was facing eviction
item.description: The man suspected of killing two people and injuring six others in a mass shooting at a downtown Minneapolis apartment complex Wednesday was facing eviction after a string of incidents including assault and allegedly showing a gun to apartment management, according to court documents.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell to return to "CBS Mornings"
item.description: Norah O'Donnell will be joining Gayle King and Nate Burleson as co-host of "CBS Mornings" starting Tuesday, Sept. 8. It will be a homecoming for O'Donnell, who co-hosted the broadcast from 2012 to 2019.

item.title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies at 92
item.description: Gloria Steinem has died at the age of 92. Before 1974, single women often needed a man to co-sign for loans, and married women could only get credit cards in their husbands' name. That changed thanks to Steinem and the women's movement she helped lead. Norah O'Donnell looks back on the life of the feminist icon.

item.title: As Trump warns of larger attacks on Iran, Vance downplays situation, saying U.S. is not at war
item.description: Vice President JD Vance took the podium in the press room on Thursday, holding a rare briefing following last week's departure of White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt. Vance downplayed the war with Iran, saying he wouldn't even call it a war. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: What led to officer-involved Minneapolis shooting
item.description: Two people were killed, and several others were wounded, in a shootout with police in Minneapolis on Wednesday. The suspected gunman was also killed. Jonah Kaplan reports on the details.

item.title: Remembering the achievements of feminist leader Gloria Steinem after her death at 92
item.description: Women's activist Gloria Steinem died Thursday at the age of 92. Tarana Burke, activist and founder of the MeToo movement, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss her legacy.

item.title: Video shows moments after woman shoots man over Walmart parking spot
item.description: Warning: Disturbing footage. Newly released video shows the moments after a woman fatally shot a man over a parking spot outside a Walmart. The Broward County State Attorney said they released the video to explain their decision not to charge her. Jason Allen has more details.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to rule on mail-in ballot rules
item.description: The Justice Department is asking the Supreme Court to intervene in President Trump's fight for more stringent mail voting rules. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman has more.

item.title: Single holdout juror preventing unanimous verdict in Lindsay Clancy trial, defense claims
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's defense attorney said a single juror is all that prevents a unanimous verdict in her murder trial. He said the claim came in a note from the foreperson, who said the holdout juror is not following the judge's instructions on "reasonable doubt." The jury of nine women and three men is weighing the question of whether Clancy is criminally responsible for the killing of her three young children.

item.title: Lawyer explains why Supreme Court is allowing Trump's new White House ballroom to be built
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled this week that construction may continue on President Trump's new ballroom despite a lawsuit from the National Trust for Historic Preservation. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson weighs in.

item.title: Americans turning to "buy now, pay later" loans for rent, food, and other necessities
item.description: Buy now, pay later loans exploded in popularity during the pandemic as a way to split up large consumer purchases. Now, people are using them to afford everyday necessities. CBS News MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo breaks it down.

item.title: Trump planning to campaign for dozens of Republicans in key states as midterms approach
item.description: President Trump announced his plans to campaign with dozens of Republicans in battleground states ahead of midterm elections in an effort to help his party retain control of Congress. CBS News' Zak Hudak has more.

item.title: Former Trump adviser says he would "give the economy a B" grade despite high gas prices
item.description: As the midterms draw closer, mortgage rates have hit a new high for 2026, and gas prices are above $4 per gallon. Former Trump economic adviser Stephen Moore joins "The Takeout" to assess the state of the U.S. economy.

item.title: House cancels last 2 weeks of September session as midterms loom
item.description: The House of Representatives returned to Washington, D.C., at the beginning of the week, and they'll be leaving the nation's capital sooner than previously thought. Political strategists Joel Payne and Sean Cooksey join with analysis.

item.title: Attorney shares biggest takeaways from Day 6 of Lindsay Clancy deliberations
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's triple murder trial has yet to return a verdict after six days of deliberations. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul reports and legal contributor Caroline Polisi offers analysis.

item.title: Mark Sanchez files motion for guilty plea in stabbing incident
item.description: It wasn't immediately clear what charges Sanchez was pleading guilty to, but he is facing a felony battery charge and several misdemeanors, including unlawful entry of a motor vehicle and public intoxication.

item.title: Vance "extremely skeptical" U.S. strike hit Iran wedding party
item.description: Iran responded to a warning from President Trump with claims of new strikes against U.S. forces in Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Missouri's top court blocks new House map favoring GOP until voters can weigh in
item.description: The Missouri Supreme Court has blocked a new House map backed by President Trump from being used in the November election, a setback in Republicans' efforts to pick up an additional House seat.

item.title: DOJ charges ICE officer who shot immigrant with lying to investigators
item.description: Federal prosecutors have charged an ICE officer who shot a Venezuelan immigrant in Minnesota with making false statements about the incident, sources said.

item.title: Iowa GOP gubernatorial nominee Zach Lahn credits victory over Trump ally to "being on the ground"
item.description: Democrats have not occupied the governor's mansion in Iowa since 2011, but a new Emerson poll reveals that the race is in a dead heat. Republican gubernatorial nominee Zach Lahn joins "The Takeout" to discuss his campaign.

item.title: From 2006: Gloria Steinem on the continuing fight for equality
item.description: Gloria Steinem, a trailblazing figure in the women's liberation movement, died on Sept. 2, 2026 at age 92. In this Jan. 22, 2006 "Sunday Morning" profile, Steinem talked with correspondent Erin Moriarty about the progress made toward gender equality since the founding of Ms. Magazine, and of the work still to be done.

item.title: How the Pentagon's design enabled hundreds to evacuate to safety on 9/11 | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: When a 757 hit the Pentagon on 9/11, it miraculously struck the only section of the Pentagon renovated to resist a terrorist attack. Hundreds were able to safely evacuate.

item.title: DOJ asks Supreme Court to allow Postal Service rules on mail ballots
item.description: The Justice Department asked the Supreme Court to intervene in an ongoing legal battle over U.S. Postal Service rules for mail ballots just weeks before the November midterm elections.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy jury leaves without verdict, defense wants juror dismissed
item.description: A sixth day of jury deliberations in Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial ended Thursday without a verdict.

item.title: 9/11 memorial service should be about remembrance, not politics, Mamdani says
item.description: This year's 9/11 memorial service will be Zohran Mamdani's first as mayor of New York City.

item.title: American automakers urge Congress to ban Chinese vehicle sales in U.S.
item.description: Chinese cars can collect and send consumer and vehicle data to Beijing, U.S. automaker group warns in calling for a ban on sales.

item.title: 9/3: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: No verdict in Lindsay Clancy murder trial after six days of deliberations; Vance holds first White House press briefing since Leavitt's departure.

item.title: AI interviews rolling out for some federal hires, sources say
item.description: The federal government will shift into using artificial intelligence in the interview process for some job applicants in the coming days, according to U.S. officials.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell returning as co-host of "CBS Mornings"
item.description: Norah O'Donnell​ is returning as co-host of "CBS Mornings" alongside Gayle King and Nate Burleson.

item.title: People turning to BNPL loans to pay for rent, food and other necessities
item.description: More consumers are taking out "buy now, pay later" loans to make ends meet, a sign of the U.S. affordability crisis, according to consumer advocates.
